description: UX B1 (olife_b1): Injector in hand = «my mobs» mode. 3 windowed F2F 0.32 clients (alice, bob = admin, carol = stranger) + real olife-sandboxd. alice: demo_orbit sample (running) + two stopped benches; bob: one bench. Panel on M (only with the Injector): rows = the account's benches of the world (eid, name, status, position, loaded, credits/fuel/KV), bob sees only his, carol none, watch refresh, select -> HUD marker + world highlight; camera V: third person (3..6 bl, looks at the mob, follows it) -> from the eyes (<= 1 bl) -> own camera; rescue: the world drops a bench 25 bl underground, «Спасти» -> MobConfirm (nothing moves), wrong token -> 23, «Подтвердить» -> back to the last safe position (<= 1 bl) + MobRescued + sound, carol -> 3; destroy: without confirmation the bench stays, «Отмена», stale token -> 23, with confirmation gone + a last-state slot, carol -> 3; restore: KV + look set, operator /kill (A2) -> dead row, carol -> 3, «Восстановить» + confirm -> new eid with the same code_fnv/model/texture/KV, RUN and moving, again -> 26; editor: 3 saves -> 3 commits, tab «Профиль» (owner, rights, hash), «Вернуть» #2 -> 4 commits and the world's code = v2, «Открыть» #3 -> text in the editor, a syntax error on line 2 -> ERROR + «ошибка в строке 2» + caret on it.
